item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Supacode 0.11.7
item.description:
macOS coding agent

Supacode is a native coding agent command center for macOS. It can run and manage more than 50 command-line coding agents simultaneously in a unified interface. It is suitable for engineering teams and individual developers who need to split tasks, develop in parallel, and centrally view the execution status. The software is based on libghostty and does not rely on Electron or web encapsulation to provide startup speed, input response and operation experience close to the native terminal. It adopts the open mode with its own agent, which can directly run CLI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, etc., without additional protocol conversion layers, and does not change the user's existing terminal habits and working rules. Each agent receives a separate Git worktree that enables multiple tasks to advance simultaneously in an isolated environment, reducing file overlays, branch conflicts, and interference with each other. Supacode also integrates GitHub workflows into the endpoint environment, enabling the creation of pull requests, checking continuous integration status, and handling merge conflicts, keeping encoding, validation, and collaboration in a coherent operational path.

item.title: Lockpaw 1.7.2
item.description:
macOS Screen Mask Tool

Lockpaw is a native menu bar screen masking tool for macOS that temporarily blocks desktop content and reduces misuse while AI programming agents, build tasks, downloads, or SSH sessions continue to run. The default shortcut Command Shift L or the custom key combination overrides all monitors and automatically overrides new screens accessed during masking. The software supports Touch ID authentication to unlock and password backup authentication, and intercepts keyboard, scrolling, and trackpad gesture input. After accessing Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot or Aider, the agent will trigger a soft light and notification when requesting permission or completing a task, or optionally forward the reminder to the phone. The optional lid-on mode of operation allows the MacBook to continue to perform tasks without an external monitor and resume the sleep mechanism when it is unlocked, the machine overheats, or the battery level drops to 20 percent. The interface supports origami cats and dogs, customized images, and time-lapse pure black display, providing shortcut commands and command line integration, no account required, and no analysis data collected.

item.title: TaskTick 1.25.2
item.description:
macOS Scheduled Tasks Manager

TaskTick is a native macOS timed task management lightweight tool, using SwiftUI and SwiftData to develop and reside in the menu bar, through an intuitive "reminder" interface to achieve flexible date, time, recurrence scheduling, support for direct embedded writing or local .sh/.py/.rb/. js script execution, built-in a variety of practical script templates (database backup, log cleaning, health check, etc.) and allows users to create their own templates for classification management, providing execution logging (standard output/error, exit code, time-consuming), system notification alerts for task success or failure, one-click import from system crontab, English and Simplified Chinese bilingual switching, GitHub automatic update detection, etc., perfectly replacing tedious cronta b with launchd, a minimalist and efficient productivity assistant for macOS 15 Sequoia and above users (Apple Silicon and Intel are compatible) to implement local automated script timing, lightweight background task scheduling, and bid farewell to complex command-line configurations. You can use it through Homebrew's one-click installation or direct download of the latest v1.1.0 dmg package…

item.title: Muxy 2.4.0
item.description:
Mac Terminal Multiplexer

Muxy is a lightweight endpoint multiplexing tool for endpoint multitasking workflows, built using Rust, GPUI, and libghostty, with an emphasis on memory efficiency, suitable for users who need to handle multiple command-line tasks, development projects, and AI programming agents at the same time. The software provides background sessions, remote sessions, and split panes to facilitate the organization of different terminal tasks in the same work environment, and supports the management of parallel development work through Git worktree. It also offers extension mechanisms, AI programming agent integration, and more than 490 themes, allowing users to adjust the terminal environment based on toolchain and visual preferences. In addition to the desktop app, Muxy offers a TUI, standalone command-line tools and server, and mobile companion apps for iOS and Android. Mac desktop requires macOS 14 or later, supports both Apple Silicon and Intel models, and can be installed via Homebrew or DMG.

item.title: TabFlick 0.26.3
item.description:
Mac Browser Tab Switcher

TabFlick is a browser tab switching and unified search tool for macOS that works with browser extensions through native apps to provide a recent Arc-like switching experience for Chrome, Edge, Brave, and other Chromium browsers. Hold down Control and tap Tab to browse the tabs, release the button to confirm the switch, make the round trip between the two commonly used pages more stable, and do not mistakenly mark the passing tag as used. The software supports page thumbnails, landscape bars, and grid layouts, and preserves a separate order of use by window. The search panel can centrally find open and recently closed tags, bookmarks, history, favorite folders, and installed apps. It supports full Chinese spelling and phonetic initial matching, single-character spelling error tolerance, and sorting according to the selection record. Users can also invoke cross-browser search from any app, perform link copying, page reload, repeat tag cleaning, and folder opening. Fixed label recovery, automatic cleanup of idle labels, menu bar lists, and custom shortcuts further simplify day-to-day management.

item.title: Snapzy 2.2.0-beta.6
item.description:
Lightweight native screenshots

Snapzy is a lightweight native screenshot and recording tool for macOS that focuses on local processing, privacy first, and open source transparency for users who need to efficiently record screen content, organize materials, and quickly share. It supports area screenshots, scrolling screenshots, screen recordings, quick access, and history management, and can call up recent captures in the menu bar at any time, reducing the cost of repeatedly switching windows. The built-in editor adds arrows, text, highlighting, and background effects directly to screenshots. OCR recognition also extracts text from pictures or videos to the clipboard, making it easy to take notes, organize data, or re-edit. The software emphasizes native performance and low resource consumption, supports offline use, uploads to its own cloud storage service only when selected by users, and is suitable for Mac users who focus on efficiency, stability, and data control. Snapzy is a lightweight native macOS screenshot and recording app that integrates common screen capture, annotation, text recognition, and sharing processes into a simple and efficient interface that emphasizes local operation, privacy first, and low resource footprint for Mac users who need to process screen content frequently.

item.title: DaVinci Resolve Studio 21 21.2
item.description:
Professional video editing software

DaVinci Resolve 21 is the only powerful software tool in the world that integrates professional video editing, color palette, visual effects, motion graphics, audio post-production, and photo editing. Its elegant and modern interface lets novices get started quickly, while providing professionals with Hollywood-grade depth capabilities to use the camera's raw-quality images from start to finish, eliminating the need to switch between multiple applications to complete the entire post-process. The software is divided into several dedicated pages, including the new Photo page, which introduces Hollywood's advanced color palette tool for the first time to still photo processing, supports camera native raw files such as Canon, Fujifilm, Nikon, and Sony, reprograms and crops at source resolution, manages media through Albums, and applies the full DaVinci color palette toolset, ResolveFX, and FusionFX. Designed for urgent projects, the Cut page uses source bands, dual timelines, intelligent editing tools, and Multi Source real-time multi-location editing to greatly improve clipping speed.

item.title: LitPads SoundBoard 1.9.9
item.description:
Mac Live Audio Routing Tool

LitPads is a custom soundboard app for musicians, DJs, podcasters, live streamers, theater and live event voice controls, and content creators that creates multiple soundboards on Mac, iPhone, and iPad, imports your own audio files, and triggers playback with ultra-low latency. It supports one-time triggering, looping, switching, press-and-hold playback and other modes. Each Pad can independently adjust the volume, audio, fade, EQ, tone change, clip range and reverb, and provide multi-voice playback. It is suitable for live performances, program crossovers, stage prompts, church and theater cue, TikTok/Reels material production, and live workflows such as OBS, Twitch, YouTube Live, Discord, and Zoom. The Mac side can be used with virtual audio drivers for audio routing. Functions such as MIDI control, track serialization, automatic depression, global fade-out, cue list, and iCloud synchronization make complex performance processes easier to manage.

item.title: Verso 1.0.65
item.description:
Native Lightweight Word Processor

Verso Writer is a native lightweight word processor for macOS that emphasizes fast startup, focused writing, and reliable document compatibility. It opens and saves DOCX, Markdown, RTF, ODT, TXT and other common formats for collaboration between Microsoft Word, Google Docs, LibreOffice, GitHub and other workflows. The software provides compact toolbars, elegant page layout, focus mode, paperless mode, a variety of page appearance, table of contents, annotations, revisions, footnotes, header and footer, tables, images, find replacements and word count and other writing and typesetting capabilities. Markdown files can be visually edited and preserved in rich text, and code blocks support syntax highlighting; BibTeX and CSL JSON reference management can generate references in multiple formats. The app is built with SwiftUI and AppKit. It does not rely on Electron, web view or cloud account. The interface supports multiple languages. It is suitable for Mac writers who need low burden, privacy-friendly, and full-featured.

item.title: Unread 5.1.3
item.description:
Reeder Alternative/RSS Feed Tool

Unread, an RSS reader designed to help users rediscover the joy of reading, offers beautiful typography, good handling of feed-only feeds, and a variety of color themes for Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Unread highlighted the free sync between devices via the Unread Cloud service, which also supports syncing with services like Feedbin, Feedly, Fever, Inoreader, and NewsBlur. For feeds that only include a post feed, Unread automatically displays the full text on the webpage, and users can freely switch between the feed text and the webpage text, or even set the default webpage text display for a single feed. Unread offers "Subscribe in Unread" and "Save to Unread" sharing extensions that make it easy for users to subscribe to websites or save posts while browsing the web (subscription required). Unread also offers a variety of color themes, widgets to display the number of latest or unread articles, comprehensive VoiceOver support, web text and image caching for instant loading and offline access (subscription required), and native support for a variety of later-reading services.

item.title: HamHub 1.7.2
item.description:
Mac Net Drive with IPTV Video Player

HamHub – Your personal audio-visual expert is a multi-device home audio-visual management and playback macOS app that unifies cloud drives, media servers, and local/network resources into a single, clear repository that helps users organize scattered video files into a searchable, renewable, and synchronized private film and television center. It supports Alibaba Drive, Baidu Drive, Google Drive, WebDAV, SMB, Plex, Emby, Jellyfin, IPTV, FTP/FTPS and other sources. It can also automatically identify movies, TV series, variety shows and other structures, and intelligently generate covers, details and episodes. The app has a built-in highly compatible player that supports 4K, Dolby Vision, HDR, Dolby Atmos, ISO Blu-ray Disc, multi-track and rich subtitle formats, and provides a picture-in-picture, continuous playback, gesture control, and speed-doubling viewing experience. Collections, viewing progress, and playback records sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV for users who want to efficiently manage their private library.

item.title: Frset 1.3.17
item.description:
Mac Everyday Tools One-Stop Integration

Frset – Clipboard & Tools is a local priority clipboard manager and productivity toolkit for macOS that combines clipboard history, screenshots, quick searches, Markdown notes, calendar events, developer tools, AI tips, and system monitoring into one lightweight workspace. It can organize and copy content by text, image, link, file, code and other types, supports Markdown preview, code highlighting, line number display, multi-label management and floating panel, and is convenient for repeated calls to commonly used materials. The application also provides rounded corner screenshots, sticky annotations, color pickup, QR code generation, JSON formatting, timestamp conversion, variable naming, Base64 and URL codecs, image compression, and other high-frequency functions. Many results can be written directly back to the clipboard, reducing switching between multiple gadgets. Frset pays attention to local processing and privacy experience, the interface is smooth, and the menu bar can view CPU, memory, SSD, network speed and schedule information, which is suitable for developers, content creators and heavy Mac users to improve daily operation efficiency.

item.title: xCal 2.2.0
item.description:
Lunar/Calendar Management Tool

xCal is a powerful calendar app that includes bi-directional syncing with Apple calendars and reminders, allowing users to easily view events and reminders from the menu bar and quickly open them with a single click. At the same time, the app provides full-screen notifications to make sure important things don't go unnoticed. Users can quickly add items by creating events or reminders in smart natural language, such as typing “Friday at 7pm to watch a movie.” A unified timeline view gives users a clear view of all events and reminders on one timeline, including an accurate display of future and recurring items. xCal also supports date countdown, allowing users to select any date to view the remaining days, including the Chinese calendar of the Lunar and Gregorian calendars, covering public holidays, adjusted weekdays, twenty-four solar terms, and more. Users have the flexibility to choose what to display on their calendar to see the information they need in a minimalistic way. Other features include a personalized look, custom menu bar icons, pinned windows for quick access, global shortcuts, and more to ensure an efficient calendar management experience, with more coming in the future.

item.title: Vitals 1.10.3
item.description:
macOS Activity Monitor Alternative

Vitals is a system resource monitoring tool for macOS that can be used as an alternative to activity monitors in daily use, combining the statistics of applications and their auxiliary processes to visually present the CPU, memory, energy consumption, disk, and network occupancy of each application, helping to locate sources of stuttering, heating, and power consumption. The software supports custom menu bar readings and charts, saves local history for up to a year, and sends notifications when applications continue to experience high loads, memory growth, or disk and network activity anomalies. For development scenarios, Vitals organizes development servers and ports by project, marks idle services, displays Docker container resource usage, tracks programming agent sessions and their launched subprocesses, and provides information on AI program balance, reset time, and token usage. Built-in MCP services and command-line tools for Claude, Codex, Cursor, or script queries for system status. It also integrates independent application volume, temperature and fan, battery health, Bluetooth device power, GPU and neural network engine monitoring.

To-do widget: integrate to-do function to help users manage daily tasks and improve work efficiency. item.title: MindSpace 1.10.30
item.description:
Lightweight, concise mind mapping tool

MindSpace is an app designed to quickly create concise mind maps that users can edit on their Mac, iPad, and iPhone and export images or PDFs at any time to share while learning and working. The software allows users to quickly adjust the information structure, distinguish ideas by different colors and formats, insert stickers to make the information more vivid, and provide a rich theme style to help users build a fortress of knowledge. MindSpace also enables the quick capture of inspiration, turning instant ideas into a piece of knowledge with a minimalistic look that puts information at the heart and reduces distractions. At the same time, MindSpace ensures data security and full ownership of the user's data. Users can easily share intuitive mind maps to improve team efficiency. The app adopts a subscription model, users can choose monthly or annual subscriptions, and need to cancel the auto-renewal 24 hours before the end of the subscription, the current subscription fee is not refundable, all terms of service and precautions please read carefully.

item.title: SubManager 2.1.2
item.description:
Subscription Tracking Expiration Reminder Assistant

SubManager is an app designed to help users centrally manage their subscriptions, enabling them to track all their subscriptions in one place. Developed using the latest technology and designed with a user interface for Apple devices that allows users to be notified in advance of subscription renewals, the app has become especially important in managing subscriptions as subscription services continue to grow. SubManager features include support for an unlimited number of subscriptions, 90-day advance notice, conversion of foreign currency subscriptions to local currency, subscription-based insights, iCloud sync, home and lock screen widgets, Siri shortcuts, comprehensive Apple Watch support, and an ad-free web app that can view iCloud data on any device. Further enhancements SubManager + is a one-time purchase that can be used on all Apple devices, and features available on iOS include classification, payment methods, price history, additional information in insights, expired subscription archives, expiration notifications, storing lifetime subscriptions, app locks, exporting and importing in JSON/CSV format, and changing the app icon to a local currency logo on an iPhone or iPad.

item.title: LicenseManagerPro 5.5.0
item.description:
macOS Software Key License Management Assistant

LicenseManagerPro is a software license management tool for Mac and iPad that helps users organize scattered keys, purchase dates, expiration dates, update support status, and related files in one place. It supports up to 4 keys per license, is suitable for family, team and multi-device authorization scenarios, can also add custom fields for vendors, invoice numbers, internal references, activation links, etc., and supports text, numbers, dates, URLs and attachment types. The app has built-in smart expiration reminders and update period notifications, so you can set an early reminder time as needed to avoid missing out on renewals; With private iCloud real-time sync, Mac and iPad data are always the same, independent of third-party servers. Users can also quickly manage large software collections with color classification, bulk editing, full-text search, recent viewing, attachment archiving, automatic icon import, and enhance privacy protection with Touch ID and automatic locking.

item.title: Exporter 5.0.0
item.description:
Apple Notes Exporter

Exporter is a tool designed for Mac that helps users export all their notes in one click from Apple Notes.app, allowing them to be exported in Markdown or HTML format while preserving their full creation and modification dates. The Exporter will follow Notes. the name of the notebook in the app is created to store the corresponding folder structure to ensure that the notes are organized in the same way as the original app. For notes with the same name in the same notebook, the Exporter will automatically rename them to avoid overwriting the old notes with the new ones. The software fully supports the export of all attachments, including images, PDF documents, Word documents (docx), MP4 videos, MP3 audio, MOV, GIF, SVG images, ICS calendar events, and call recordings. Non-image attachments are attached as links at the end of the notes for easy access. The Exporter also provides selective export functionality, allowing users to select specific notebooks for export through folder filters, and supports custom Markdown header and file name formats, with date prefixes added to file names for easy management.

item.title: TickerBar 180

Stock Crypto Forex Commodity Real Time Scroll Quotes Tool

TickerBar is an elegant desktop quote scroll bar application (macOS platform) for investors, traders and financial enthusiasts, which can display real-time prices and percentage fluctuations of stocks (supporting NYSE, NASDAQ, TSX and other markets), cryptocurrencies, Forex currency pairs and commodities (such as gold, silver, crude oil) on the top or bottom of the screen, with highly customized functions including font style/large Small/scrolling speed adjustment, up and down arrow visual prompts, can choose any display and full-screen immersion mode, suitable for multi-screen work environment seamless integration and background operation does not interfere with productivity, the new version adds dense and stock market fear greed index sentiment instrument, real-time stock market opening/closing status prompts to help users keep abreast of market pulsations without frequent switching applications, instantly transforming the entire screen into a personalized financial dashboard, A smooth, intuitive and continuously updated market insight experience.

item.title: Floodtide 1.5.2
item.description:
App updater for macOS

Floodtide is an app updater for macOS that reads the latest version information from each app's own Sparkle update feed and from the Homebrew catalog, then scans supported apps and updates them in bulk. It needs no hand-maintained app database and no Homebrew installation, and it checks official downloads and checksums published by developers. Apps whose update source can't be verified are listed clearly rather than guessed at. It offers one-click Update All, automatic backup before updating, undo of recent updates within seven days, and checks of code signature, Gatekeeper results and developer team before installing. It supports macOS 13 or later on Intel and Apple Silicon, keeps its app list on your Mac, and needs no account or special permissions.

item.title: CrewTower 1.0.41
item.description:
Lingdong Island AI Agent Request Approval

CrewTower is a native AI agent session management tool for macOS users that centralizes tasks from desktop applications, editors, and terminals such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, and opencode into a floating capsule at the top of the Mac or on other displays. Users can view task progress, context usage, running status, completion reminders, and requests that need to be processed without frequently switching windows. They can also directly approve or reject supported commands, answer questions, select solutions, review plans, and submit feedback. For dangerous operations, CrewTower displays clear warnings and provides options such as one-time, current session, or always allow. Jump takes the user back to an accurate app window, tab, terminal window, panel, or tmux pane.

item.title: Backdrop 2.10.7
item.description:
Powerful 4K live wallpaper engine for macOS

Backdrop is a live wallpaper and video desktop tool for macOS that turns your desktop and lock screen into smooth visual scenes. It supports 4K video wallpapers, browsing community creations, importing your own videos, multi-display playback and playlists. You can filter community wallpapers by style, color, mood, resolution or creator, or quickly make your own background from a video. It is optimized for Mac with hardware acceleration, plays smoothly on Retina and multi-screen setups, and lowers resource use when apps are full screen or the Mac is on battery. Its lock screen video wallpaper support keeps the desktop and lock screen visually consistent.

item.title: Tuck Pro 1.4.13
item.description:
Hide menu bar icons on Mac

Tuck is a native menu bar organizer for macOS 14 to 27 that tidies up the growing pile of app and system icons. In Push mode, one click hides the menu bar icons to the left of Tuck and another click restores them; on notched MacBooks, hidden items appear in a Shelf panel below the menu bar. You can drag icons to reorder them, set each to always show, always hide or follow the main toggle, and control it with shortcuts. Pro adds auto-hide, show-on-hover, per-app visibility rules and Shelf customization. It is under 10 MB with no telemetry; the free version has no time limit and Pro is a one-time license for up to three Macs.

item.title: Shotbolt 1.3.0
item.description:
macOS screenshot annotation software

Shotbolt is a screenshot and screen recording tool for macOS that combines multiple capture methods, layered callouts, text recognition, and history retrieval in one workflow. Unify shortcuts to launch areas, windows, full-screen or timed screenshots, fine-tune selections with freezing screenshots, pixel magnifiers, size tips and arrow keys, and toggle text extraction, scrolling screenshots, video recording, or GIF capture from the action bar. After the screenshot is saved, the arrows, text annotations, and overlays remain separate layers that you can continue to move, hide, adjust, or rotate to make it easier to modify descriptions and protect sensitive information. History supports searching by file name and text in screenshots, and displays the line where the hit text is, with automatic classification and easy-to-read headers to help find elements. Quick access cards support callouts, pinning, and dragging in other apps, and Pro provides automatic desensitization, multi-graph canvas, and more. Text recognition is done by Apple's local technology, and screenshots are only uploaded when the sharing link is actively created, and there is no need to register an account. The software requires macOS 26 or higher and is compatible with Apple chips and Intel Macs.

item.title: Vidnip 2.0.7
item.description:
macOS Web Video Sniffer Downloader

Vidnip is a video download and media management software for Apple Silicon Mac that supports macOS 14 and above, combining web video detection, download, format conversion, and local playback in one app. After pasting the page link, the software can identify MP4, WebM, HLS/m3u8 and dash videos through traffic monitoring. Combined with the yt-dlp engine, it covers more than 1800 sites, automatically downloads segments in parallel and merges them into a playable MP4, supporting image quality selection, breakpoint continuation, batch link processing and channel update subscription. The built-in video library organizes content by source, filters unwatched items and remembers playback progress; The music library supports audio extraction, album and artist browsing, tag management, and scrolling lyrics. The subtitle feature supports downloading site subtitles, exporting text, and generating subtitles or lyrics using native speech recognition on macOS 26 and above. With the iPhone app, you can also sync music, transfer videos, play back, and remotely send download links.

item.title: Ganella 1.0.4
item.description:
macOS Program Dock Dock Widget Tool

Ganella is a native Dock tool for macOS 14 Sonoma and later that combines app launch, folder access, and live widgets in one dock. It imports pinned apps and folders from the system Dock, preserves common features like trash bins, notification icons, icon enlargement and auto-hiding, and lets supported app interactive widgets present information about music playback, calendar scheduling, browser tabs, notes, and development and AI tools. The software is compatible with Spotify, Music, Safari, Chrome, Xcode, Terminal, ChatGPT, Codex, Claude and other applications. Other applications are still displayed with plain icons. The built-in clipboard history makes it easy to access the copied content again, and the volume and device change prompts help to keep up with the status; multi-monitor users can set the edge of the Dock for each screen separately. The interface offers four styles with custom accent colors, where Liquid Glass requires macOS 26.

item.title: MacMix Studio 2.3.6
item.description:
Mac App Standalone Volume Control

MacMix is a lightweight macOS menu bar audio mixing tool that uses the native SwiftUI interface to centralize system volume, app independent volume, output device switching, and microphone management in a compact panel that can be adjusted without opening system settings. The software can individually turn down the vocalizing application and enable a volume boost of up to 200% on demand, automatically remembering the volume of each application and resume at the next playback. For external monitors that support DDC/CI, the speaker volume can be directly controlled, and the slider can be muted when it drops to zero; at the same time, the AirPods, speakers, and AirPlay receiving devices can be switched, and the microphone input volume can be adjusted. Audio is processed locally on your Mac in real time and is not recorded, saved, uploaded, or required to register for an account. The core functions are open source under the mit license, and the Studio extension in the distribution provides functions such as application equalizer, multi-device output, scene preset, microphone lock, and theme customization.

item.title: Glyphs 4 4.2
item.description:
Professional font design tools

Glyphs 4 is a professional font editor for macOS for font designers, glyph engineers, brand designers, icon makers, and those looking to learn font design. The software provides an intuitive and efficient drawing environment for precise editing of Bézier curves, nodes, stroke thicknesses, endpoints, and corners, as well as support for batch curvature adjustment, balance handles, and coordination curve segments. Through the multi-master font and interpolation function, users can manage complex font families, quickly generate static fonts and variable fonts; the component system can reuse glyphs, anchors, and icon shapes, so that modifications can be applied to related characters simultaneously. Glyphs 4 supports visual spacing adjustment, contextual even spacing, OpenType features, real-time text preview, and multiple color font formats to directly check long text, word weight changes, and typography effects. The software also integrates Python 3 script editing and debugging, plugin manager, glyph batch processing, master browsing and rich export capabilities, supports CFF, CFF2, TTF, WOFF, WOFF2, PNG, SVG, PDF and SF Symbols and other formats, covering the entire process from sketching, glyph production to font publishing.

item.title: PopClip 2026.11
item.description:
Mac Scribing Translation Efficiency Tool

PopClip is an app that simplifies text manipulation without the need for a right-click for instant text manipulation. Whenever a user selects a piece of text, PopClip automatically pops up a small menu that provides basic features such as cut, copy, and paste, as well as advanced tools such as translation, spell check, word count, and unit conversion. Users can easily format text using PopClip, such as bold, italics, underscores, case conversions, and adding quotes. PopClip also supports one-click searches for selected text across multiple search engines (such as Google and Bing) and websites (such as Wikipedia and YouTube). The app is compatible with a variety of other applications, providing convenient operation options to help users work efficiently. PopClip is the ideal tool to enhance your workflow. PopClip is an app that makes your life easier, enabling instant text manipulation without the need for a right-click. Whenever you select a piece of text, the app automatically pops up a small menu with suggested action options.

macOS screen color temperature auto-adjustment/f.lux replacement

item.title: TabBarForPowerPoint 2.2.1
item.description:
PowerPoint Multi-Window Management

TabBar is a productivity tool for the Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Supplemental Documents tab bar for macOS that displays the currently open collection of documents, workbooks, and presentations above the active window, quickly switching files by clicking on the tab, eliminating the need to repeatedly expand the window menu, use the Dispatch Center, or find files in a list. The tab bar automatically follows the active Office window, fits when you move or resize the window, appears only when the app is in focus, and automatically hides when you leave Office to reduce distractions to your desktop space. The user can drag the handle on the right to adjust the width of the tab bar, the settings will be preserved at the next start, and the shortcut keys can be used to quickly display or collapse. The software resides in the menu bar, does not occupy a docking location, does not install plug-ins to Office, and supports on-demand setup login startup. It reads only the name of the open file and places the selected window in the foreground, without reading, modifying or uploading the content of the document, without registering an account or logging in.
